correctness.rationale: Step-by-step proof: two adjacent graph edges can lie in only the shared-vertex star or their endpoint triangle, so pair query codegree is ≤2; depth-four mistake tree would need ≥4 concepts on two distinct + queries, contradiction. K_n stars and triangles are all maximal cliques; all 3-spoke and triangle labelings have explicit witnesses; every larger/nonintersecting support is excluded, yielding exact coefficients. Independent checker exhaustively tested 1094 labeled graphs of order ≤5 and K4–K6; those tests supplement, not replace, the proof. No unproved general graph exact rank is asserted.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a sharp, graph-size-independent optimal online mistake bound for a natural line-graph concept system with polynomially growing hypothesis count, and a complete coefficientwise shattered-support classification for all complete graphs. The universal two-positive-query structural obstruction is mathematically reusable; the result is not merely a table entry or a renaming of maximal stars and triangles. Unrestricted individual-graph exact ranks and historical completeness are not claimed.
